campaign.name: 35: One foundation, three experiences
campaign.objective: Train text-only, image-caption-only, and joint text-image sibling foundations from one neutral root and one exact dependency-ordered 2,500-concept curriculum, then measure whether visual and verbal learning share representations.

contract.development_stage: fresh foundational bootstrap: receptor, encoder, Cortex, and expression coordination
contract.purpose: Compare three matched foundational experiences while qualifying the first full-Cortex visual-learning path; preserve mechanistic, behavioral, and structural evidence without automatic ranking or promotion.
success_criteria: All siblings begin from one exact neutral root and use one exact dependency-ordered 2,500-concept list.
The visual and joint siblings reuse identical accepted image, caption, receptor-feature, and event-order bytes.
Every weight-changing job emits the required observer fixture and is followed by behavioral chat and MRI evidence.
Terminal siblings receive full MRI, Atlas, 3D map, and cross-modal comparison evidence.
failure_criteria: Any lesson or visual event is shuffled, reordered, skipped, or admitted without its dependency certificate.
Any training job lacks its bound observer evidence or the observer changes a paired qualification trajectory.
A visual run modifies the receptor or parent checkpoint in place, trains a scope other than the authorized scope, or produces an unloadable checkpoint.
Identity material classifies Ninereeds by consciousness, substrate, species, AI, LLM, or model category.
Loss is used to rank, reject, promote, or define success for a sibling.
expected_regressions: Immature or nonsensical language while encoder and expression coordination develops.
Temporary loss of recently accessible material after later concepts.
Different apparent competence across text and image probes despite shared concept order.
Non-monotonic behavior and geometry while loss remains telemetry only.
contract.hypothesis: If image and word experiences converge on shared Cortex structure, matched concepts should become mutually accessible across modalities; if they remain separated, within-modality performance and geometry will diverge despite identical order.
observations_sought: Text-to-image and image-to-text transfer on trained and unfamiliar examples.
Recency, interference, regression, and recovery across the 2,500-concept order.
Whether joint interspersion protects, disrupts, or binds the two modalities.
